instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the PWA manifests and Service Worker configuration are correctly declared for PWA installability.
Implement state persistence using localStorage so user check-ins, gratitude logs, brain dumps, single intention, discernment entries, and burden release items persist seamlessly.
Provide two distinct parcours: PARCOURS A (Mindset & Équilibre) and PARCOURS B (Chrétienne & Sagesse), swappable anytime via profile/header path switcher.
Ensure both Light Theme (soft natural stone & sage) and Dark Theme (nocturnal sanctuary dark indigo/slate) are functional with a persistent toggle in header.
Include both an Audio Player with demo ambient tracks/guided meditations AND an interactive animated visual breathing/coherence guide with selectable times (2 min, 3 min, 5 min).
Provide rich French demo content for both paths: daily verses, guided prayers, business ethics parables, anti burnout sabbatical guidelines, flash pauses, and community testimonials.
Ensure every interactive element features explicit data-testid attributes for automated verification.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App text-align center).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use generous spacing. Containers with border must have padding on text content to avoid collision.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
